summary: We have developed a website that displays images from NASA’s SPHEREx mission, making them easily accessible to everyone.
details:
• Objective: A web application to search, visualize, and analyze infrared astronomical data from NASA's SPHEREx mission (0.75 – 5.0 µm across 102 spectral channels).
  • Core Features: Coordinate entry, file imports (JSON, CSV, FITS, images), an interactive timeline player for time-series and comparison, and automated spectrum/light-curve plotting.
  • Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Aladin Lite, and sky survey APIs.
  • Key Highlights: An intuitive "all-in-one" interfacefeaturing a smart offline/demo fallback mechanism to ensure seamless operation during presentations.
